review: DonutChain 的宿主候选从到期终止进入，但最终只报告整入口授权。此入口也完成购买、找零、记账；E21 的三项 SAT 未标出唯一到期效果，E4 仍有路径缺口。保留一个待核根，主表采用保守计法，审阅材料含另一种裁决的完整数值。

target_findings.explanation: The assessment concerns the policy governing the protected effect at source offset 249 under current_authority_required. An office established by the source controls a separate protected effect. The replacement of that office lacks the corresponding qualification. A separate entry consumes the changed qualification at the linked source location.
